material.description: The OECD DAC definition supplies the primary conceptual basis for civil society as voluntary association distinct from states, private for-profit enterprises and the family. The recommendation is directed to development co-operation and humanitarian-assistance providers; it is not a universal national legal definition.
material.locator: OECD/LEGAL/5021, Section I, definition of “civil society”: voluntary human association/interaction for shared needs, ideas, interests, values, faith and beliefs, distinct from states, private for-profit enterprises and the family; Section I, definition of “CSOs”.
